title: Response bid.mtype carries a value outside the documented 1-4 enum range

knownGap.note: Response bid.mtype (OpenRTB 2.6 List: Markup Types, values 1=Banner, 2=Video, 3=Audio, 4=Native) is never validated by Core: MTYPE_TO_FORMAT in packages/core/format-detect.js silently ignores any value outside 1-4 for detection purposes, and rules-response.js contains no reference to mtype at all, so an out-of-range value such as 5 produces no finding of any kind.

core: ^response:\ missing\ required\ finding\ expected\.response\.bid\.mtype_invalid_enum\ @\ seatbid\[0\]\.bid\[0\]\.mtype\ \[error\]\ params=\{"mtype":5\}\ —\ got\ version\.single_marker\[info\]@$
http: ^response:\ missing\ required\ finding\ expected\.response\.bid\.mtype_invalid_enum\ @\ seatbid\[0\]\.bid\[0\]\.mtype\ \[error\]\ params=\{"mtype":5\}\ —\ got\ version\.single_marker\[info\]@$
browser: ^browser\.response:\ missing\ required\ finding\ expected\.response\.bid\.mtype_invalid_enum\ @\ seatbid\[0\]\.bid\[0\]\.mtype\ \[error\]\ params=\{"mtype":5\}\ —\ got\ version\.single_marker\[info\]@$

specNotes: OpenRTB 2.6's Markup Types list defines exactly four values (1 Banner, 2 Video, 3 Audio, 4 Native); a bid declaring mtype:5 uses a value the specification does not define and should be flagged the same way any other undocumented enum value is flagged elsewhere in this codebase (field-local error, not silence).

grep of packages/core/rules-response.js confirms zero references to `mtype`; format-detect.js's MTYPE_TO_FORMAT table is a lookup used only for the format-detection axis (chips/tags), not a validation rule, and an unmatched key is simply skipped there with no side effect.
notes: Browser acceptance 2026-09-08 independently reproduced the existing semantic/preview deviation through the actual Analyze action. Only the reviewed failure strings are admitted on the browser layer; all declared assertions remain unchanged.
